invariant: A handler reports support only after consuming the complete admitted declaration and retaining its identity/options. Unsupported variants produce explicit command residue rather than silently truncating identifiers or suffixes.
causal_divergence: The partial declaration regex ends before the end of line, accepts only word identifiers, requires spaces before stereotypes/colors and puts order after color. Java identities include dot/@ and optional stereotypes can touch the identity; ORDER precedes URL/COLOR. Negative order cannot be represented in the current usize model.
planned_change: Anchor the supported declaration language, retain complete Java identity characters and compact options in their source order, preserve existing full-label handling. Reject unsupported handler variants before mutation so the existing registered-command warning reports them nonfatally. Keep negative order as explicit unsupported execution rather than a silently ignored sort key. Do not expand renderer sorting or family dispatch.
perturbation_axes: compact stereotype/color and positive/negative order with declaration topology
